name: New Game Blasterwars
description:
Galaxite is a featured Bedrock Edition Minecraft Server, made by Blockception.

Players can choose 6 game modes to play; Core Wars, Prop Hunt, Fill The Gaps, Chronos, Hyper Racers and Rush. They can play with friends, earn achievements and try and get onto the leader boards. Galaxite has a small but friendly player base on Minecraft Bedrock Edition.
